title: Find a Pair · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Find a Pair · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a visible property such as color, shape or material. The lead identifies two different objects in the room sharing that property. The group confirms that both objects share it. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Find a Pair, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group confirms that both objects share it.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group confirms that both objects share it.
